_comment: Cebuano function-word policy (tunatale-u8nz.4, 2026-09-25). Same POS-first shape as tl/no/sl, but Cebuano has no lemma table yet (lemmatizer_type is the shared 'lowercase', which emits no UPOS), so 'pos' is inert today and 'include' is the whole policy. 'include' names the genuine difficulties for an English speaker: the case markers ang/sa/og, 'ug' (and), the personal-name markers si/ni/kang, the plural 'mga', the linker 'nga', and the second-position particles ba/pa/na/pud/sad/lang/ra/man/gyud/diay/kaha/unta. Tagalog's 'ng' and 'po' are deliberately absent: they are NOT Cebuano, and the style guide treats them as contamination. ORCHESTRATOR-DRAFTED, not native-checked (tunatale-u8nz.9).
